art_instructions: Draw a charming woodland schoolhouse with warm brown wooden walls, a bright yellow door, and wide windows. The roof is steep and metallic, and a small bell tower sits atop. The school is on short stilts with tiny steps leading to the entrance. A wraparound porch is visible. Owl stands just inside the doorway, looking around curiously. She is perched upright, with her tiny satchel on her back and her green scarf neatly tied. Her amber eyes are wide, and her posture is alert and engaged. Surround the school with tall oak trees, scattered leaves on the ground, and small flower beds of daisies and clover. The scene is sunny with bright, diffused lighting. Owl is the only character present, centered in the image as she enters.
